status: Development conversion profile; not generally adopted
admission: Select the unchanged PNG-only inspector when no embedded JPEG exists, otherwise the unchanged JPEG inspector. Keep every closed static-GLB/PNG/JPEG feature and resource guard; no relabelling old profiles, no external resources or new encoding.

records.variantFamilyId: Mapped distinct Native Proxy family; preserve its identity, never substitute the GS family.
records.proxyForGsVariantFamilyId: Exact mapped Native GS family in the same Asset.
records.derivedFrom: Recipe-7 import emits exactly [mapped Native GS Representation ID]. Saved records permit [] or exactly one same-Asset GS Representation ID in the proxyForGsVariantFamilyId family. Review wire omits this field; its saved edit-copy explicitly carries []. Empty arrays require no private ancestry proof and imply no Native provenance. Clean/continuing-history outputs preserve/remap retained nonempty arrays.

representationToAsset: Existing target canonical positive Sim3 plus reflection none/x, preserved exactly; use the checked binary64 transform of development-native-point-ply-rgb-1. No normalization.
bounds: Asset-frame conservative AABB from all eight corners of the verified raw GLB AABB, including its authored node poses. Retain raw GLB bounds separately for the pinned loader proof; never overwrite them with Asset bounds.
materialCatalog: Existing gltfMaterial(index) or implicit representationMaterial(0) locators, unchanged source semantics. No Native appearance override may target a Proxy; no new Proxy material editing.
display: Wrap the cloned decoded root in a separate representationToAsset Group; retain all authored node transforms. No color/depth writes, excluded from fit. New interaction is DoubleSide as in existing target 01c, which differs from Native FrontSide. Never reraycast or move saved pins.
